recognize_zh: 低倍下可見大量密集、形狀相近的濾泡，濾泡內細胞核呈 BCL6 棕色陽性，濾泡間區則大多陰性，勾勒出背靠背（back-to-back）的濾泡結構，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma）的生發中心表現型。
features: Numerous closely packed, variably sized nodules effacing the nodal architecture at low power
Nuclear BCL6 positivity concentrated within the nodules (germinal center B-cell phenotype)
Interfollicular zones largely BCL6-negative with scattered positive cells
Follicles lack a distinct mantle-zone rim and show little size/shape variation, some confluent
Weaker staining pale areas within some follicles
describe_en: Low-power BCL6 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows effacement of the architecture by numerous crowded, back-to-back neoplastic follicles. The follicles show nuclear BCL6 expression, while the intervening interfollicular tissue is largely negative, highlighting the nodular pattern. Staining supports a germinal center B-cell derivation of the follicles; distinction from reactive follicles requires BCL2 co-expression and architectural/cytologic correlation. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are BCL6-positive too but are well separated, vary in size and shape, have polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Marginal zone cells are BCL6-negative, so BCL6 staining is confined to residual colonized germinal centers rather than filling the entire nodule.
Mantle cell lymphoma nodules are BCL6-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
